long long modAdd(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return ((long long)a % mod + (long long)b % mod) % mod;
}

long long modSub(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (((long long)a % mod - (long long)b % mod) + mod) % mod;
}

long long modMul(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return ((long long)a % mod) * ((long long)b % mod) % mod;
}

long long findBinaryExponentian(int a, int pow, int mod) {
    if (pow == 1) return a;
    if (pow == 0) return 1;
    long long retVal = findBinaryExponentian(a, pow / 2, mod);
    long long val = (pow % 2 == 0) ? 1 : a;
    return modMul(modMul(retVal, retVal, mod), val, mod);
}

int findPow(int a, int b, int mod) {
    if (b == 1) return a % mod;
    if (b == 0) return 1;
    long long res = findPow(a, b/2, mod);
    res = (res * res) % mod;
    if (b % 2 == 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
    return res;
}

int bleft(int ele, int sortedArr[], int size) {
    int l = 0, h = size - 1, ans = -1;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (sortedArr[mid] < ele) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;
        } else {
            h = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int div = b;
    int rem = a % b;
    while (rem != 0) {
        int temp = rem;
        rem = div % rem;
        div = temp;
    }
    return div;
}

long long logFunc(long long no, long long n) {
    long long i = 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    long long sum = 0;
    while (i < no) {
        sum += i;
        cnt++;
        if (sum == n) {
            return ((long long)cnt);
        }
        i *= 2;
    }
    return cnt;

vector<int> primeList(int MAXI) {
    vector<int> prime(MAXI + 1, 0);
    unordered_set<int> obj;
    for (int i = 2; i <= (int) sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i++) {
        if (prime[i] == 0) {
            obj.insert(i);
            for (int j = i * i; j <= MAXI; j += i) {

    return vector<int>(obj.begin(), obj.end());

int optimSearch(int* cnt, int lower_bound, int pow, int n) {
    int l = lower_bound + 1;
    int h = n;
    int ans = 0;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] == pow) {
            return mid;
        } else if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] < pow) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;

            h = mid - 1;
        }

    return ans;

pair<long long, int> ret_ans(const vector<int>& ans) {
    int size = (int) ans.size();
    int mini = 1000000001;
    long long tit = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        tit += ans[i];
        mini = min(mini, ans[i]);
    }
    return {tit - mini, mini};
}

int factorList(unordered_map<int, int>& maps, int no, int maxK, int req) {
    int i = 1;
    while (i * i <= no) {
        if (no % i == 0) {
            if (i != no / i) {
                put(maps, no / i);
            }
            put(maps, i);

            }
            if (maps[no / i] == req) {
                maxK = max(maxK, no / i);
            }
        }
        i++;
    }
    return maxK;
}
